title: 6.5.2 Check: the Pocket game
description: Five multiple-choice questions on the pointer, direction and speed, drag and the stop rule, and a pocket you roll over. Checked instantly.

questions.question: Which one is true on exactly one frame?
questions.explanation: presses() is true on the frame of the press; pressing() is true every frame it is held.

questions.question: On screen, which way does a sprite with direction 90 move?
questions.explanation: 0 is right, 90 is down on screen, 180 is left, 270 is up.

questions.question: You pull away from the ball and let go. Which direction sends the ball away from the pointer?
questions.explanation: The shot goes opposite the pull, so add 180 degrees.

questions.question: Why does `cue.speed === 0` never become true while drag is on?
options: Drag slows it every frame but never to exactly zero
questions.explanation: Drag multiplies the speed down each frame, so it approaches zero without reaching it. Test against a small number instead.

questions.question: A ball overlaps a pocket. How often is `overlaps()` true while they overlap?
questions.explanation: overlaps() is level-triggered, so the drop needs a guard to happen once.
